name: @zabaca/agentgit
description: Watch a walgit repository and keep a clone current — one socket, no cursor, no config

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/agentgit.js --target=node --minify-whitespace --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/agentgit.js
scripts.publish:npm: bun run build && bun publish --access public
